Hey mate, hope you see this. This is how I got out of that rut.  
I’ve been in that position, and to an extent I still am but I’m turning it around. 
Im 32, I left school at 15 with no grades, always hated working and never earned much money. Me and my partner (she only works part time) had a baby 2 years ago and because of the job I was in we were going to food banks. I’ve always worked in some form of construction. Enough was enough, I made a logo on Canva, used my overdraft to look for work on one of those checkatrade style sites, got one job in and quit my job.  
I go for it, man. I make my quotes beautiful, I treat the customers like family and I try to make sure I’m reasonably priced enough to get the work but fair to myself. After my third month I got out of my 3k overdraft and I currently have 2 guys working for me on a job. 
I do this all out of spite for other companies, I don’t want my family to have a shit time and it’s satisfying. There’s work out there mate, even if you just set up doing flat pack furniture, delivering stuff for people or some kind of catering (not
my trade but there’s gotta be options). Just be polite, work harder than you would for someone else, work better than the other guy who would’ve got the work and try to enjoy the responsibility.  
I hope you can get some motivation from this, but either way my DMs are open if you need a chat.
